Let me update the docs file to match the cop's new comment, to keep them in sync:", "role": "assistant", "tool_calls": [{"function": {"arguments": "{\"command\":\"str_replace\",\"new_str\":\"Use `File::NULL` instead of hardcoding the null device (`/dev/null` on Unix-like\\nOSes, `NUL` or `NUL:` on Windows), so that code is platform independent.\\nOnly looks for full string matches, substrings within a longer string are not\\nconsidered.\\n\\nHowever, only files that use the string `'/dev/null'` are targeted for detection.\\nThis is because the string `'NUL'` is not limited to the null device.\\nThis behavior results in false negatives when the `'/dev/null'` string is not used,\\nbut it is a trade-off to avoid false positives. `NULL:`\\nUnlike `'NUL'`, `'NUL:'` is regarded as something like `C:` and is always detected.\\n\\nNOTE: Uses inside arrays and hashes are ignored.\",\"old_str\":\"Use `File::NULL` instead of hardcoding the null device (`/dev/null` on Unix-like\\nOSes, `NUL` or `NUL:` on Windows), so that code is platform independent.\\nOnly looks for full string matches, substrings within a longer string are not\\nconsidered.\\n\\nNOTE: Uses inside arrays and hashes are ignored.\",\"path\":\"/testbed/docs/modules/ROOT/pages/cops_style.adoc\"}", "name": "str_replace_editor"}, "id": "call_-7350018593532143560", "index": 0, "type": "function"}]}}], "created": 1700000171, "id": "synthesized-00171", "model": "glm-5.2", "object": "chat.completion", "request_id": "synthesized-00171", "usage": {"completion_tokens": 0, "prompt_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 0}}
